title: Fight Breaks Out At HEB In Frisco, Texas [Watch]
htmlContent:
It was a busy Thursday afternoon at the HEB Grocery store in Frisco, Texas, as customers went about their shopping for the week. But suddenly, chaos erupted as two customers got into a heated argument near the entrance of the store.

Eyewitnesses reported that the altercation started over a disagreement about a parking space, but quickly escalated into a full-blown physical fight. The two customers were throwing punches at each other, shouting insults and causing a scene that attracted the attention of other shoppers and HEB employees.

Thankfully, the store's security team was quick to respond and rushed to the scene to separate the two customers. It took several minutes to break up the fight and calm the situation down, but eventually, the two customers were escorted out of the store separately.

HEB's security team immediately alerted the local police department, who arrived at the store shortly after the incident. They took statements from witnesses and reviewed security camera footage to gather evidence for a potential investigation.

The store manager later issued a statement, thanking the security team for their quick action and apologizing to customers who witnessed the altercation. They also reminded customers to be respectful and courteous towards each other, especially in a public setting like a grocery store.

The incident serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining civility and respect towards others, even in stressful situations. It also highlights the crucial role of security teams in keeping public spaces safe and diffusing potentially dangerous situations.

HEB has not released a statement regarding the incident as of yet.
